messages:
maria_cs: FYI customer VoltPay just escalated — several typed fields in the assistant's structured response started returning strings instead of their typed values after yesterday's rollout. They rely on numeric and boolean types for downstream ingestion and are failing fast.

maria_cs: Example from customer (expected vs actual):
```
# expected (schema v3.1)
{
  \"amount\": 12.34,
  \"tax_included\": true,
  \"line_items\": [ { \"sku\": \"A123\", \"qty\": 2 } ],
  \"settled_at\": 1688390400
}

# actual (post-rollout)
{
  \"amount\": \"$12.34\",
  \"tax_included\": \"yes\",
  \"line_items\": \"A123 x2\",
  \"settled_at\": \"2024-07-03T00:00:00Z\"
}
```

maria_cs: They first saw it ~2026-03-15 11:02 PDT when we flipped traffic to model: alpine-2026-02-18. Customer says ~30% of events now rejected by their parser.

ashok_eng: Thanks, investigating. @deploy-bot can you confirm what exact variant rolled and whether any output-normalization transforms shipped with that model?

deploy-bot: Deploy: model alpine-2026-02-18 v2.3 rolled to prod canary 20% at 2026-03-15T11:00:12Z (initiated by kevin_prod). No config transforms flagged in deploy metadata.

ashok_eng: Ok collecting request IDs and an example request from customer. Can we get the original prompt (obfuscated) and the request_id they provided? Also need runtime logs + model shard.

maria_cs: Customer provided request_id rc-7a9c and the conversation snippet. Pasted above. They also gave one failing payload with request_id rc-7a9d. Both from 11:02 and 11:05 PDT.

ashok_eng: Reproducing locally against alpine-2026-02-18@v2.3 with same prompt... getting the stringified fields as well. Looks like the model's completion policy switched to more natural-language wrappers for typed slots.

kevin_prod: Is this a model-behavior change or did any output postprocessing layer change? We didn't update the output sanitizer in prod. If it's model-induced, we should consider throttling canary and pin big customers to old model.

ashok_eng: Confirmed: the runtime logs show model token patterns inserting currency symbols and ISO timestamps instead of numeric primitives. No sanitizer step altered. Likely a behavioral regression from the new model weights.

sre_oncall: Customer impact: high for VoltPay (parser rejects). Suggest immediate mitigation: 1) rollback canary to previous model or 2) route VoltPay to pinned model with old behavior. Which is preferable?

kevin_prod: Short-term: route VoltPay to alpine-2026-01-30 (pinned). Maria — can you ask VoltPay if they accept routing for now? I'll prepare a canary pause and rollback plan.

maria_cs: VoltPay agreed to be pinned for now. They want timeline on full fix + whether we can provide a compatibility guarantee.

ashok_eng: Next steps for eng: open issue to add stricter structured-output instruction constraints during model onboarding and add an eval check that validates JSON token types (numbers/booleans vs quoted strings). For immediate patch we can add a postprocess step that coerces obvious types (strip leading $ from amounts, parse ISO datetimes to epoch, map yes/no to booleans) — to be opt-in and gated to affected customers.

kevin_prod: Also add a regression alert to Redwood Optimize so future rollouts trigger a structured-output check against seed prompts from top 10 customers.

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 20% (manual) by kevin_prod at 2026-03-15T11:18:03Z.

ashok_eng: I'll create the internal ticket with logs, model samples, and a reproducible test. Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml for root cause.

maria_cs: Filing CS ticket and emailing VoltPay summary + temporary pin details. Will keep thread updated. :white_check_mark:

kevin_prod: Good triage. If eng recommends rollback we will coordinate an immediate rollback with SRE.

sre_oncall: Standby for rollback window. I'll collect on-call list and runbook.

ashok_eng: One more note — adding quick heuristic to request router that detects stringified currency (regex like ^\$?\d+\.\d{2}$) and rewrites to numeric for known customers as a short-lived safety net. Will PR today.

maria_cs: Thanks all. Will follow up with VoltPay and update CS ticket.
